acceptance: The exact implementation changes only crates/morize-core/src/decision.rs and crates/morize-core/src/lib.rs.
morize-core publicly exports MemoryActionSetVersion alongside the existing MemoryAction without changing the existing 11-action vocabulary.
MemoryActionSetVersion is a non-exhaustive in-memory enum with exactly one current variant, V1, and no numeric representation, discriminant contract, textual parser, or wire encoding.

V1 is documented and tested as the version identifier for exactly the existing Store, Update, Merge, Supersede, Contradict, Expire, Forget, Redact, Quarantine, Ignore, and RequireReview MemoryAction vocabulary; no additional action is introduced.
The version value grants no authorization, target selection, threshold, policy decision, mutation authority, execution, side effect, or storage behavior.
MemoryActionSetVersion supports Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, and Hash; focused tests prove V1 value semantics and exact binding to the current action vocabulary without defining ordering.

The implementation defines no DecisionEnvelope, candidate reference, action scores, confidence, abstention, reason codes, evidence references, engine identity, policy revision binding, replay semantics, serialization, persistence, API, MCP, or domain-record integration.
cargo fmt --all -- --check passes on the exact implementation head.
cargo check --workspace --all-targets --offline passes on the exact implementation head.
cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --offline -- -D warnings passes on the exact implementation head.
cargo test --workspace --all-targets --offline passes and executes the focused action-set-version tests.
Cargo manifests and Cargo.lock are unchanged; the Grain adds no runtime, build, dev, or test dependency.
GitHub Actions passes Ubuntu, macOS, and Windows on the exact implementation head before acceptance.

An independent semantic reviewer reviews the exact implementation head for V1-to-current-vocabulary fidelity, future-extensible non-exhaustive version semantics, absence of wire/numeric/authority semantics, scope containment, prerequisite identity, and required evidence.
ADR-0004 proof prerequisite SG-000018 revalidates against the exact WorkPacket baseline before execution.

method.control: Implementation is limited to one dependency-free in-memory MemoryActionSetVersion enum in the existing decision module, focused tests, and morize-core re-export. V1 binds only the existing 11-action MemoryAction vocabulary. No numeric/text/wire encoding, DecisionEnvelope, authority, execution, policy, serialization, persistence, or third-party dependency is authorized.
method.review_separation: An independent semantic reviewer must review the exact implementation head for V1 binding to the exact current 11-action vocabulary, non-exhaustive future-version semantics, absence of numeric/text/wire and authority semantics, exact prerequisite identity, scope containment, and required evidence separately from the implementing agent before acceptance.
method.rollback: Revert the SG-000026 action-set-version implementation commits; no persisted format, serialized decision, authorization rule, mutation side effect, or user data depends on this Grain.

minimality.rationale: The typed DecisionEnvelope requires an action-set version, while the current MemoryAction vocabulary is already independently proven. A one-variant non-exhaustive in-memory version enum is the narrowest next contract: it binds V1 to the existing vocabulary without prematurely fixing serialized version numbers, parsing, envelopes, authority, thresholds, or persistence.

requirements: The version identifier is descriptive compatibility metadata only and must never grant mutation authority or bypass policy.
No numeric or textual encoding is fixed in this Grain because the exact serialized DecisionEnvelope schema is explicitly deferred by the planning documents.

outcome: morize-core exposes one dependency-free non-exhaustive MemoryActionSetVersion with V1 bound to the already-proven closed 11-action MemoryAction vocabulary, without defining serialized version encoding, DecisionEnvelope fields, authority, policy, persistence, or side effects.
rationale: P1 requires a typed DecisionEnvelope, docs/TYPED_DECISION_MODEL.md states that the closed action vocabulary is versioned, and SG-000018 deliberately deferred action-set version binding. This Grain closes only that in-memory compatibility identity so later DecisionEnvelope work can bind an explicit action vocabulary version without inventing wire encoding or authority semantics.

risk.recovery: Revert the SG-000026 action-set-version implementation commits; no persisted format, serialized decision, authorization rule, mutation side effect, or user data has been written by this Grain.

scope_in: Define public non-exhaustive MemoryActionSetVersion with exactly V1 as the sole current in-memory version identifier.
Bind V1 semantically to exactly the existing 11 MemoryAction variants proven by SG-000018, without adding or renaming any action.
Derive Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, and Hash and add focused standard-library-only tests for V1 value semantics and exact current-vocabulary binding.
Keep the version contract future-extensible while leaving numeric/text/wire encoding to a later serialized DecisionEnvelope Grain.
scope_out: Any numeric repr/discriminant contract, Display/FromStr parser, serde or other serialization integration, persisted/wire encoding, schema field name, migration, storage, API, MCP, or configuration format.
